auth.recoverBody: Type the recovery code that was printed when this business was set up. A new recovery code will be created afterwards. Only the Owner can be reset this way.
auth.mismatch: The two entries do not match.
auth.recoverDone: PIN changed. Your new recovery code is below. Print it and keep it safe.
wiz.title: Welcome to PetraDMS
wiz.languageBody: Choose the language you want to use. You can change it later in Settings.
wiz.businessBody: This appears on invoices and reports.
wiz.ownerBody: The Owner can see everything and change settings. Choose a PIN or a password that you will remember.
wiz.folderBody: Your sales, stock and customer records are saved in one folder on this computer. A folder on a different drive from Windows (for example D:) is safer, because reinstalling Windows can erase the C: drive.
wiz.mode: How do you want to start?
wiz.modeBody: Simple shows six big buttons and is best for staff. Full shows every screen. You can switch at any time.
wiz.modeSimple: Simple: Sell, Buy, Stock, People, Money, Reports
wiz.recoveryBody: If you forget the Owner PIN or password, this code is the only way back in. There is no cloud reset. Print it now and keep the paper somewhere safe, away from the computer.
wiz.recoveryWarn: This code is shown only once.
wiz.recoveryConfirm: I have printed or written down my recovery code
wiz.printNote: Keep this paper safe. Anyone with this code can reset the Owner PIN.
biz.name: Business name (English)
owner.name: Your name
owner.usernameHint: Letters and numbers only, for example rahim
set.title: Settings
set.negStock: Allow selling when stock is zero (negative stock)
set.negStockHint: Off is safer. Products that track expiry never go negative.
set.creditMode: When a customer is over their credit limit
set.minPrice: When staff sell below the minimum price
set.taxHint: 0 means no tax line. Example: 5 or 7.5
set.roundOff: Round invoice totals to the nearest taka
set.rollover: New business day starts at (hour, 0 to 8)
set.rolloverHint: Sales after midnight but before this hour count for the previous day.
set.idleLock: Lock automatically after minutes without use (0 = never)
set.userReset: Set a new PIN or password
set.roleHelp.owner: Everything, including settings, backup and users.
set.roleHelp.manager: Sells, buys, adjusts stock, sees cost and profit. No settings.
set.roleHelp.staff: Sells and receives payments. Cannot see cost or profit.
set.secretChanged: Your PIN or password was changed.
set.purchaseCharges: Show a VAT / other charge field on company purchases
set.purchaseChargesHint: The charge is added to the bill and to the cost of the goods. Leave off if your companies never charge it.
set.logoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 256 KB. It shows at the top of the menu and on printed documents, and is kept in every backup. Without a logo the first letter of your shop's name is shown.
set.logoType: Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP picture.
set.logoSize: The picture is too big. Use one under 256 KB.
